matrixTitle: ResumePilot AI — Blast Radius & Failure Classification Matrix

evaluatedFailureScenarios.scenario: Total Firestore Quota Exhaustion (RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / Code 8 / HTTP 429)
evaluatedFailureScenarios.userFacingImpact: ZERO — User login, resume edit/create/save, live preview, export, AI generation, and checkout continue at 100% on MariaDB
evaluatedFailureScenarios.workerBehavior: Worker classifies error as QUOTA_EXHAUSTED, pauses aggressive polling with exponential backoff + jitter, preserves events in RETRYING state, resumes automatically when quota resets
evaluatedFailureScenarios.dataIntegrity: ZERO data loss — events remain durable in MariaDB sync_outbox

evaluatedFailureScenarios.userFacingImpact: ZERO — MariaDB handles all read/write queries directly with low latency (<15ms)
evaluatedFailureScenarios.workerBehavior: Worker classifies error as TRANSIENT_UNAVAILABLE, retries at 5-second interval without dead-lettering valid business mutations
evaluatedFailureScenarios.dataIntegrity: ZERO data loss — outbox preserves transaction order

evaluatedFailureScenarios.scenario: Worker Crash / PM2 Worker Restart Mid-Replication
evaluatedFailureScenarios.affectedStandby: In-flight outbox events stuck in PROCESSING state
evaluatedFailureScenarios.workerBehavior: Surviving or restarted worker invokes lease reclaim query at the start of every cycle, returning PROCESSING rows older than 120s to RETRYING
evaluatedFailureScenarios.dataIntegrity: ZERO data loss — events re-replicated safely due to idempotent target handlers and monotonic revision guard

evaluatedFailureScenarios.workerBehavior: replicateToFirestore and replicateToMySQL compare incoming event version against current target revision; older/stale events are acknowledged without state overwrite
evaluatedFailureScenarios.dataIntegrity: Target database maintains strictly monotonic forward progress

evaluatedFailureScenarios.userFacingImpact: Sub-second graceful switch with mutex-serialized verification
evaluatedFailureScenarios.workerBehavior: flushAndVerifyBeforeSwitch verifies zero pending outbox events before updating active engine configuration in memory and audit ledger
evaluatedFailureScenarios.dataIntegrity: Guaranteed 100% data parity before role reversal
